findings.evidence: Lines 60, 146, and 159 are the only `@[expose]` definitions found in the relevant API; lines 154 and 187 characterize only `hom.hom`. The preceding `fgPointNatIsoHom` API provides both hom and inverse component lemmas, and Mathlib's `LaxMonoidalFunctor.isoMk` constructs both `hom` and `inv`.
findings.fix: Remove the three `@[expose]` attributes and add `[simp]` lemmas identifying `.toFunctor`, `(fgPointTensorIso ...).inv.hom`, and `fgPointTensorIsoHom ... g = fgPointTensorIso ... g`; keep the existing hom equation.
findings.issue: `fgScalarExtensionMonoidalFunctor`, `fgPointTensorIso` (line 146), and `fgPointTensorIsoHom` (line 159) are all `@[expose]`, while the API lacks an underlying-functor equation, an inverse equation, and a direct homomorphism-application equation respectively.

summary: The new bundled constructions expose implementation bodies instead of providing a complete characteristic API.
